basic_details.job_title: RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 32 Faculty Posts
basic_details.short_information: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) has released the RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026 notification for 32 Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor vacancies, including 13 backlog posts. The online application process started on 22 October 2026 and closes on 22 December 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official RGNAU Samarth recruitment portal.

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates

application_fee.details: The RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026 application fee is ₹1,000 for Unreserved, OBC-NCL and EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the application fee. The processing fee is non-refundable.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026 direct recruitment is 50 years for Professor, 45 years for Associate Professor and 40 years for Assistant Professor. Age will be calculated as on 22 December 2026. Government of India and UGC relaxation rules apply where eligible. | Eligible candidates belonging to reserved categories may receive age and qualification relaxations under applicable Government of India and UGC rules. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the relevant conditions.

The University's lists are indicative and not exhaustive.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Teaching Salary 2026 - Post-wise Pay Scale
content_sections.text: RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026 offers pay under the applicable 7th CPC pay matrix. Professor posts carry Level 14 pay of ₹1,44,200-₹2,18,200, Associate Professor posts carry Level 13A pay of ₹1,31,400-₹2,17,100, and Assistant Professor posts carry Academic Level 10 pay of ₹57,700-₹1,82,400 per month. Additional allowances are admissible as per rules. The starting basic pay is ₹1,44,200 for Professor, ₹1,31,400 for Associate Professor and ₹57,700 for Assistant Professor. Actual gross and in-hand salary will depend on applicable allowances, deductions and other service conditions. The notification does not specify a fixed in-hand salary amount. Suitable residential accommodation may be provided in the University campus as per allotment rules. Appointees will be governed by the National Pension System (NPS).

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Teaching Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026 selection involves scrutiny of applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates and assessment by the University. Selection may include an interview and other notified assessment methods. The University may apply academic and research scoring criteria, additional screening requirements and post-specific selection procedures. Application Screening: Verification of eligibility, academic qualifications, teaching/research experience and submitted information. Shortlisting: Selection of candidates for further assessment based on prescribed qualifications, academic/research scores and University criteria. Interview / Assessment: Shortlisted candidates will receive details of applicable interview or other selection stages through their registered email. Document Verification: Candidates must produce the required original certificates and supporting documents. Is There a Written Exam for RGNAU Teaching Recruitment 2026? The notification does not announce a fixed written examination pattern, syllabus or confirmed exam date. However, it mentions possible screening tests, written tests, presentations, group discussions and personal interviews. Candidates should follow subsequent official recruitment updates for the assessment applicable to their posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) for appointing teaching staff across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 32 vacancies have been announced for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 22 December 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Unreserved and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/-, while reserved categories are exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Professor posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for direct recruitment to the post of Professor is 50 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the relevant discipline with NET or Ph.D., along with required experience as per UGC guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Through which mode can applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively in online mode through the official recruitment portal provided by the university.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: Associate Professors are placed under Level 13A of the Pay Matrix with a salary range of Rs. 1,31,400 to Rs. 2,17,100/-.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University located?
faq.answer: The university is located in Fursatganj, District Amethi, in the state of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these teaching positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes screening of applications, shortlisting based on academic scores, followed by a presentation and personal interview.
